item.title: Three Distinct Cycling Logo Options

turns.text: Give me three different logo options for my cycling club, Moss & Mile. Simple green and black on white, each with the name and a small symbol. Your call on the symbols, but make them genuinely different ideas. Three separate square images please, not a collage.

item.tests: Produces exactly three separately usable logo variations with distinct concepts and consistent required wording.

answer_sheet.Exact wording: Moss & Mile on every option, including the ampersand; no extra text.
answer_sheet.Number and delivery: Three separate square images, not one collage or contact sheet.
answer_sheet.Style and palette: Simple cycling-club logos using green and black on white.
answer_sheet.How different the options should be: Three genuinely different symbol or layout concepts, not just recolors of one design.

must_haves: Exactly three separate square logo images are delivered.
Each logo clearly reads 'Moss & Mile', including the ampersand.
Each option includes a small symbol alongside or above the name.
The three options have visibly different symbol or layout concepts, rather than only color changes.
All three use green and black on plain white backgrounds without mockup scenes or option labels.

turns.text: Give me three different logo options for my cycling club, Moss & Mile. Simple green and black on white, each with the name and a small symbol. Your call on the symbols, but make them genuinely different ideas. Three separate square images please, not a collage.
turns.agent:
Magic Hour refused the generation because your account has insufficient credits. No images were created.

The three distinct directions I planned—all green and black on white, with the full **Moss & Mile** name—were:

1. **Moss Wheel:** A minimal bicycle wheel with green moss along the rim, above a bold wordmark.
2. **Winding Mile:** A small green winding-road symbol beside clean black lettering.
3. **Leaf Link:** A compact chain-link-and-leaf emblem above a softer, rounded wordmark.

Once credits are available, these can be generated as three separate square images—not a collage.

approvals.name: generate_image

style.prompt: One single minimalist cycling club logo on a pure white square canvas. Exact full name: "Moss & Mile", spelled clearly and correctly in bold black clean geometric sans serif typography. Small symbol centered above the name: a simple thin black bicycle wheel circle with just four spokes, with a tiny cluster of three forest-green moss tufts growing along its upper rim. Strong graphic silhouette, restrained sophisticated outdoor cycling identity. Only forest green and black flat inks on white. Clean vector-style design, generous white space, compact centered balanced lockup, name is primary and symbol small. No gradients, no shadows, no mockup, no textures, no photography, no extra text, no border. ONE logo only, not a collage or presentation sheet.
